mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, user_code, flow_no, order_no, earn_flow_no, deduction_points, status, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM points_deduction_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND earn_flow_no IS NULL AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY user_code ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deduction_points), 0) FROM points_deduction_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND earn_flow_no IS NOT NULL AND status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT id, tenant_code, user_code, flow_no, order_no, earn_flow_no, deduction_points, status, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM points_deduction_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND earn_flow_no IS NOT NULL AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_code, user_code, flow_no, order_no, earn_flow_no, deduction_points, status, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM points_deduction_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND earn_flow_no IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE points_deduction_record SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
